preconditions.expression: T == int(stdin.split()[0]) and T >= 1 and T <= 1000
preconditions.description: The first line of input is an integer T (1 ≤ T ≤ 1000) representing the number of test cases.
Each test case starts with a line containing four integers R, G, B, M (1 ≤ R, G, B, M ≤ 100) separated by spaces.

preconditions.expression: all(len(r) == R and len(g) == G and len(b) == B for r, g, b, _ in (line.split() for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:]))
preconditions.description: For each test case, the next three lines contain R, G, and B integers respectively, representing the amounts of red, green, and blue potions (1 ≤ r[i], g[i], b[i] ≤ 10^9).

postconditions.expression: all(len(stdout.split()) == T for stdout in [stdout.strip() for stdout in stdin.splitlines()[1:]] if stdout.strip())
postconditions.description: The output contains exactly T integers, one for each test case.

postconditions.expression: all(stdout.isdigit() for stdout in [stdout.strip() for stdout in stdin.splitlines()[1:] if stdout.strip()])
postconditions.description: Each output is a non-negative integer representing the minimized maximum liquid amount after at most M magic tricks.

postconditions.expression: all(int(stdout) >= 0 for stdout in [stdout.strip() for stdout in stdin.splitlines()[1:] if stdout.strip()])

all(int(stdout) == min(max(max(r), max(g), max(b)), max(max([(x >> k) for x in r]), max([(x >> k) for x in g]), max([(x >> k) for x in b])) for k in range(M + 1)) for r, g, b, _ in (line.split() for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:]))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output is the minimized maximum liquid amount achievable by performing at most M magic tricks, where each trick halves the amounts of all potions of a chosen color (using integer division).
